preparer_context: parent session operating the charness release skill; authored the notes entries under review and ran publish_release --execute to the prepared stage
reviewer_context: three bounded read-only reviewer subagent contexts (Read/Grep/Glob only; no Bash, Edit, Write or Agent), each spawned fresh against the prepared record and none given the preparer's verdict

observer_distinctness.signal: Each round ran as a separately spawned bounded-reviewer subagent whose envelope exposed only Read, Grep and Glob; each independently reported that Bash, Edit, Write and Agent were absent, and each returned findings the preparer had not written.
